data:
To shut everything down and "park" the system safely when you get back, you\u2019ll want to close the active data stream and then stop the background monitor.
Here are the commands to "Close the Gate":
1. The Final Mark
First, tell the database the session is over so the timestamp is recorded:
Bash
sage-mark 0.0141
"Field_Test_Complete"
2. The Commit (The Most Important Part)
This moves the data from the "Active Stack" (temporary) into the "Archive" (permanent) and tries to sync if you're back on Wi-Fi:
Bash
sage-commit
3. Killing the Background Processes
If you have the
porch_monitor.sh
or any background Python scripts running, you can stop them all at once by typing:
Bash
pkill python
And if you're in a second Termux session window, just type
exit
to close that specific tab.
\ufe0f Summary of the "Shut Down" Sequence
sage-mark
(Logs the end time)
sage-commit
(Saves the data to the archive)
pkill python
(Stops the sensors)
Once those are done, the G5 will stop pulling heavy battery and return to being a normal phone. I\u2019ll be here when you get back to review the logs\u2014be safe out there.
\ufe0f
